items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf; Schefter/Rapoport corroborate official active.
items.why: Calf minor per McVay; practiced enough for optimism then cleared.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary LAR WR with Adams out longer-term.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then inactive (quad); Rapoport said unlikely pre-game, official inactives confirm fourth straight miss.
items.why: Limited practice only; not full participant yet.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT (ankle) for Week 7; was QUESTIONABLE earlier in weekend reports.
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade; monitor for Week 8.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers may see adjusted roles.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; changes PHI pass game (Berry had pre-loved Smith volume).
items.implication: PHI WR downgrade; reverse any Smith starts.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes to remaining PHI receivers/Goedert.
items.conflict: Berry pre-game LOVE for Smith volume now stale.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos snaps 50%/rush 41%/routes 34% (Dobbins 21%); pre-called end-of-year RB you wish rostered—100% leagues now.
items.why: Immediate lead shares post-IR; Dobbins inefficient.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee (suffered vs IND) not significant, day-to-day per source.
items.opportunity: If limited, Vikings RB handcuff upside.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; ETR watching with Tracy.
items.implication: Monitor; potential limited or sit next.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle (purposeful slide) almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.implication: No downgrade; maintain elite RB ranking.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring context from prior); Berry also noted in line vs DAL.
items.implication: Start if active; efficient when healthy.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries vs soft DAL run D.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN after layoff questions; Berry hated post-layoff workload risk vs DET.
items.opportunity: Lead RB role if full go.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on post-layoff vs tough DET.

items.text: Jonathan Taylor potential trade suitors Seahawks/Broncos/Vikings/Packers per Schefter; Jadarian Price (chest) eligible W8 unsure status—SEA could use weapon beyond JSN.
items.implication: JT value hold/trade-monitor; SEA RB/WR impact if move.
items.opportunity: If JT to SEA, changes backfield/JSN context.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game no Rice); ceiling note: never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.why: Clear WR1 route share without Rice.
items.implication: Volume up but historical ceiling limits boom.

items.text: Jets: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgts career so far this yr), AD Mitchell 18 on 33 dropbacks.
items.why: Mitchell (finger) back; Cooper high efficiency on limited prior routes.
items.implication: Wilson still lead; Cooper sneaky upside.
items.opportunity: Routes split but Wilson dominant; Cooper target quality.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown (usage/matchup @CHI) and Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET allowing many TE TDs/fantasy pts); also volume RBs Warren/Hubbard/Irving.
items.why: Brown real role + CHI yards; Kraft DET TE weakness; RBs big workloads friendly matchups.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes for AJB/Kraft; carries for volume RBs.
